## Summary

Implemented PSI-102. Server action createEventBoardAction(eventId) in src/features/calendar/actions.ts: requires kanban.write, returns existing board when boards.event_id matches (idempotent, DB also enforces via idx_boards_event), else inserts board named after the event with event_id/created_by, inserts default columns (Backlog/In Progress/Done, Done is_done), then copies ONLY group audience rows into board_groups (users/roles excluded per finance.md §1). getCalendarEventsAction now attaches board_id to each event via one batched boards lookup. calendar-view.tsx shows 'Open board' (router.push /dashboard/kanban?boardId=) when board_id set, else 'Create event board' for canCreateBoard holders (spinner + inline error); calendar/page.tsx passes canCreateBoard = session.permissions.includes('kanban.write'). getBoardAction now fetches the linked event (id,title,starts_at,ends_at,all_day) when event_id set; KanbanBoardData gained event_id/event; kanban-view-page.tsx reads ?boardId= from search params and shows a 'Linked event: <title> (<date>)' chip linking back to /dashboard/calendar; kanban/page.tsx wrapped in Suspense. Added 5 unit tests (event-board.test.ts): naming+event_id+columns, groups-only audience copy, second-click idempotency, permission denial, missing event. Gates: frontend 28/28, edge functions 15/15, pgTAP 135 PASS, tsc clean, oxlint 0, agent:check ok. Acceptance: Jev not installed in this harness and /auth/sign-in 500s from a pre-existing template bug (submit-button.tsx formContext), so browser flow could not run; covered deterministically with a live local-Postgres probe (board+event_id+board_groups insert rolled back; second board for same event_id rejected by idx_boards_event) plus the shipped pgTAP case in finance.test.sql.

## Decisions

- **Idempotency enforced twice: action early-returns existing board AND DB unique index idx_boards_event**: The visible rule is 'a second click never makes a second board'; the action check gives a clean UX, the index guarantees it against races (alternatives: DB index only; app check only)
- **Only event_audience rows with group_id are copied into board_groups**: finance.md §1: boards share with users and groups only; users/roles are excluded and the creator adds people by hand (alternatives: Copy users and roles too)
- **Board URL uses ?boardId= query param (kanban/page.tsx still at /dashboard/kanban)**: Matches the existing single-route kanban page; no new route segment needed for PSI-102 (alternatives: /dashboard/kanban/[boardId] route)
